title: UNI to host higher education expert Kevin McClure for Hearst Lecture
summary_en: The 2026-27 Hearst Lecture Series, hosted by the UNI Department of Languages & Literatures, explores the theme “Care and Empathy in Academia,” bringing speakers to campus whose work examines the ways that care, community and human connection can shape education, scholarship and the academic experience.
title_cn: UNI to host higher education expert Kevin McClure for Hearst Lecture

title: 2026 University Address looks ahead as UNI celebrates 150 years
summary_en: As the University of Northern Iowa celebrates its 150th anniversary, President Mark Nook asked the campus community to consider how the work of this year will shape its future.
title_cn: 2026 University Address looks ahead as UNI celebrates 150 years

title: UNI PE major confidently embarks on student teaching
summary_en: Following a packed experience as a University of Northern Iowa student who was involved in just about everything, Brock Trenkamp is ready for his next adventure: student teaching.
